_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the benchmark problem set. Consumed by:
judge/pairwise_evaluator.py (subject -> dist dir / html naming / problem file)
Add new problems here FIRST; nothing else needs editing for a new problem

conventions.id: kebab-or-plain slug, NO underscores (variant ids are '<id>_vN')
conventions.dist_dir: dist/<id>/  — same slug as id, no spaces (legacy entries are grandfathered)
conventions.html_naming: variant_id  — lesson files are <id>_vN.html (legacy 'bare_version' entries use vN.html)
conventions.problem_file: path relative to agentic_pipeline/ with the exact problem statement
conventions.answer: canonical final answer, phrased so equivalent forms count; put non-essential detail in parentheses marked as not required

problems.title: Archer / Projectile Range
problems.answer: approximately 141 m (141.4 m with g = 9.8 m/s^2; 138.6 m acceptable if g = 10)

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.answer: target 45 is found at index 7, and binary search runs in O(log n). (Reaching it in 4 steps is supporting detail, NOT required for a correct final answer.)
